chain_focus: MLCC (Multi-Layer Ceramic Capacitors) for AI server power delivery — high-capacitance (1uF-100uF range) ceramic decoupling capacitors mounted on GPU accelerator cards (each H100/B200 uses ~10,000+ MLCCs) and server motherboards for power delivery network (PDN) stabilization. Trace from BaTiO3 raw material and Ni powder through MLCC manufacturing (Murata, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, TDK, Yageo, Taiyo Yuden) to server/GPU card OEM assemblers and final hyperscaler buyers.

contracts.signal: High-capacitance MLCCs for AI server / GPU board power delivery driving record data-center capacitor demand; server-use MLCC capacity being expanded by an emergency JPY80B investment

quarterly_data.signal: Record FY2025 (ended Mar 2026) revenue JPY1,830.9B and operating profit JPY281.8B (+0.8%), driven by higher capacitor (MLCC) sales mainly for servers; data-center-related sales rose +JPY75B vs FY2024 (+74%)
Q4 orders surged on data-center MLCCs and power products; overall book-to-bill 1.24, MLCC book-to-bill 1.36; MLCC capacity utilization near 95%

Emergency additional capacity investment for server-use MLCCs of JPY80B (on top of the medium-term plan), lifting capacity expansion to >20% over two years vs ~10%/yr prior; total FY2026 CapEx JPY250B; largest-ever JPY150B buyback, dividend raised to JPY70/share

FY2026 forecast: record revenue JPY1,960B (+7.1%), operating profit JPY380B (+34.8%); capacitor revenue +13% YoY on strong data-center demand; data-center-related sales +84% (+~JPY148B); no near-term price increases, relying on mix improvement

FY2026 plan leans hard into AI servers: 'EMERGENCY additional capacity investment' for server-use MLCCs with an order budget of ¥80B (within ¥250B total capex); capacitor revenue +13% YoY planned; total revenue ¥1,960B (+7.1%, second straight record) with operating profit +34.8% on utilization and mix. POWER MODULES launch mass production in 2026 (+~¥25B sales contribution) — vertical power delivery plus intermediate bus converters and high-voltage front-end products all being adopted. Book-to-bill: 1.24 overall, 1.36 for MLCCs. Big-picture view: electronics peaks ~every 15 years; next peak 2030 with AI-server datacenter expansion now and a large EDGE-device market forming after.
